summary: Iteration 7: Tested notification prefs (site-config flags), per-booking notification_status persistence, admin resend endpoint, admin dashboard 'Notify' column with Email/SMS badges + resend button, admin manage Site Config toggles, taxi pickup/dropoff dropdown selects with 'Other — type custom' fallback, and the new Home hero H1 copy. 7/8 backend tests pass, all frontend flows verified. One minor backend bug: POST /api/bookings response body does not include notified_at (data is persisted to DB and appears in admin GET, just missing from the create response).

minor.issue: notification_status is included in the response body but notified_at is only persisted via $set on the DB doc — the returned dict never gets booking['notified_at'] = now_iso(). Admin GET /api/admin/bookings does return notified_at correctly. Fix: after the update_one, add booking['notified_at'] = now_iso() before returning clean(booking). server.py ~ line 596-600.

issues: Date & Time field uses browser default datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy input) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DateTime component — inconsistent with app's design language.

action_items: Minor: In create_booking (server.py ~L596-600), set booking['notified_at'] = now_iso() on the local dict too so the POST response body includes notified_at (matches DB and admin GET). Update the test assertion afterward.
Optional design: replace <input type='datetime-local'> in Taxi booking modal with shadcn Calendar + time picker for consistency with the rest of the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1675 lines — same DRY/size concern from iter6 still applies; consider splitting into routers (bookings, admin, payments, catalog).

notify_booking_confirmed writes 'Disabled by admin' or 'No email address' to the same 'error' field. Consumers can't distinguish 'not sent because disabled' from 'not sent because of a provider failure' without also checking the enabled flag. Consider a separate reason/status enum (disabled|missing_contact|failed|sent).

POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/resend-notification always resends even if prefs disable email/sms — that's arguably correct (admin explicit action), but there's no override flag to force-send when prefs=false; both channels will just report enabled=false. Consider a { force: true } body param.
notified_at only being persisted (not returned in booking response) is a subtle inconsistency between POST /bookings and GET /admin/bookings for the same record.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 zelle test bookings against airport-nassau ($35 taxi) with customer name TEST_Notify User, email test_notify@example.com, phone +15005550006 (Twilio magic test number). These persist in DB with notification_status attached — safe to leave for the demo since Twilio was not actually called (creds cause 'Twilio not configured' path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login endpoint is POST /api/auth/login (not /api/admin/login as review request stated). Test module uses BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env fallback if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL isn't in env. Zelle booking path is what triggers notification_status persistence (Stripe path defers until _mark_paid). notify_email/sms status dicts contain sent/provider/error/enabled — all four keys are asserted. Frontend AdminDashboard renders NotifyCell only for paid rows w/ resend button, but Email/SMS badges appear for every booking that has a notification_status object.
rca of the issue: For the minor notified_at gap: server.py's create_booking does `await db.bookings.update_one(..., {'$set': {'notification_status': report, 'notified_at': now_iso()}})` (L596-599), then only mutates the local dict with `booking['notification_status'] = report` (L600). It never sets `booking['notified_at']`, so `return clean(booking)` omits it. GET /admin/bookings reads back from DB, so it correctly includes notified_at — that's why admin dashboard shows the timestamp fine. Fix: add `booking['notified_at'] = now_iso()` on line 600, using the same timestamp captured once.
